summary: Blue Owl Digital Infrastructure Trust filed an 8-K solely to report an increase in its distribution rate from $0.4500 to $0.5000 per share per year across all share classes. The filing is a routine capital allocation announcement under Item 8.01 (Other Events) with no M&A, activist, or restructuring implications. It contains no deal terms, strategic review, or special situation. This is a standard ongoing disclosure for a REIT, not a special-situation event.
